question: Which of the following languages was declared a classical language in the year 2014?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Odia.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Odia** is an **Indo-Aryan language **spoken in the eastern Indian state of **Odisha.**
 
• It was declared a** classical language** in the year **2014** by the Government of India.
 
• The classical language status is given to languages that have a **rich heritage and history **spanning over a period of 1500-2000 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Any language that has a substantial corpus of **prehistoric written literature **and its own **distinct literary tradition** is considered **classical.**
 
• Other languages that have been declared as classical languages in India include **Tamil, Sanskrit, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam.**
 
• **Tamil** is the **first language **to receive that designation.
 
• In **2004,** Tamil was designated as a classical language.
